subject: Final-mile MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form and signature lanes
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Tam <sara.tam@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP & signature lanes for Veridian pilot

Sara — attaching a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft order form to align on sequencing between MSA / DPA / order form. High level ask: can we lock legal review windows so we can hit a targeted signature window in early June?

Quick context: Veridian is targeting a limited pilot (30 days) and wants the MSA + DPA agreed before the pilot order form is fully executed. Procurement has historically required a PO for purchase > $20k, so if that's still the case we should plan a provisional order form with a spending cap.

Asks from our side:
- Can procurement confirm who provides the first redline (Veridian or Redwood)?
- Does Veridian require a PO prior to countersignature, or can you accept a countersigned order form followed by a PO?
- CISO / security review timeline for the DPA (approx dates requested)
- Primary signatory for order form (name/title) — helps us prepare DocuSign lanes

Proposed timeline (draft):
- 5/20: MAP + draft order form shared (attached)
- 5/24: Procurement redline back to Redwood
- 5/27: Security DPA review complete
- 6/02: Target signature window (MSA/DPA merged; order form countersigned)

Attaching: Veridian_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP), redwood_orderform_draft.pdf.

If you prefer a short 30-min sync this week to talk lanes, I can coordinate.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com
+1 415 555 0142

Subject: Re: Draft MAP & signature lanes for Veridian pilot

Chloe — thanks for the MAP and draft order form. Quick replies inline and a few attachments from procurement.

- Procurement will produce the initial redline for the MSA / order form by 5/24 as long as we have the draft pricing placeholders confirmed.
- Our CISO team will handle the DPA review separately; they need the DPA and a SOC2 report / pen-test summary. Can you provide those by EOD 5/21?
- Signature lanes: CFO (Marcus Bell) will countersign the commercial order form. Legal typically signs the MSA and Legal Counsel will be on the DPA.
- PO policy: for pilots under $25k the procurement team can skip PO pre-signature if the contract has a spending cap and an explicit acceptance window. Otherwise a PO is required prior to countersignature.

I attached: Veridian_procurement_requirements.pdf and Procurement_redline_instructions.txt (short instructions for redline format and preferred clause numbering).

We can do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 10 PT if that helps.

Sara Tam

Chloe / team — quick legal view after a first pass on the draft MSA and DPA. Notes below (we'll send a tracked redline by EOD 5/21):

Priority legal asks for Veridian to confirm:
- Order form economics: we need a clear "cap" clause if they want to avoid a PO; propose a $25,000 pilot cap as discussed.
- Data processing: we'll provide the SOC2 Type II and a concise pen-test summary by 5/21; SDLC attestation available on request.
- Liability & Indemnity: we prefer mutually capped liability tied to order form value for pilots. Expect to see our suggested cap in the redline.
- Export controls / residency: confirm whether Veridian requires on-prem or specific region hosting for this pilot.

Attachments: redwood_msa_redline_v1.docx (redline stub). We'll prepare a DPA redline as separate file for CISO review.

Two operational requests for procurement: please confirm whether procurement needs us to submit a company W-9 and completed vendor setup questionnaire prior to countersignature. If so, we'll route immediately.

I'll align with Karthik on pricing placeholders and send the full tracked documents by EOD.

Laura Bennett

Team — confirming procurement timeline and next steps after our review. Apologies for the slightly longer turnaround — wanted to confirm internal gating points.

Confirmed plan:
- 5/24: Procurement to produce redline for MSA + order form (we will use the instructions you attached).
- 5/27: CISO completes DPA review (they will circulate comments directly to Laura).
- 6/02: Target signature window. Marcus (CFO) will countersign the order form; legal will finalize MSA/DPA signatures.
- DocuSign: procurement requests that Redwood send the merged redlines as a single packet and then initiate DocuSign with separate signature lanes for Legal / CFO. Please include a signature block for the CFO on the order form.
- PO: Procurement confirms pilot under $25k can proceed without a PO pre-signature if the order form includes an explicit pilot cap.

We're good to move forward on the pilot basis above. Please send the SOC2 and pen-test summary by EOD 5/21 so CISO has materials. Once our redline is out on 5/24, we'll ask legal to converge with your redline in a single version for DocuSign.
